_comment: WORKED EXAMPLE — fictional client, invented RFP. Stage 1 output. Used to demonstrate and test the pipeline end to end; not a real bid.

engagement.title: Change Management Partner — Group ERP Replacement

requirements.text: The supplier shall deliver a change impact assessment covering all affected business units prior to system build completion.
The supplier shall design and deliver role-based training for approximately 4,200 users across 6 countries.
The supplier shall provide a stakeholder engagement and communications plan, including approach to identifying and engaging informal influencers.
The supplier shall define adoption measures and report progress to the programme board on an agreed cadence.
Suppliers should evidence prior experience of multi-country system rollouts of comparable scale.
Responses must name the proposed engagement lead and core team, with CVs provided in Annex B.
The supplier shall provide a phased fee schedule with a fixed price for the initial assessment phase.
The supplier shall describe its approach to knowledge transfer and exit at engagement close.
requirements.note: Not in the scope schedule; appears only in the evaluation criteria at 4.2 as 'sustainability of the change beyond the engagement'. Extracted as a requirement because it is scored. Worth a clarification question on the expected level of detail.

drivers: Three regional ERP instances reaching end of vendor support in 2028
Group finance cannot consolidate month-end without manual reconciliation
A prior 2023 consolidation attempt was halted after nine months
pain_points: Prior attempt left significant scepticism among plant operations teams
No standing change capability in the Group Transformation Office
Plant managers report change fatigue from three concurrent programmes
success_measures: Single consolidated month-end close by FY28 Q1
No sustained productivity loss at plant level through cutover

open_questions: R8: expected depth of the exit/knowledge-transfer response — scored but not scoped.
Whether the 4,200 user population includes contractors and agency staff at plant level; materially changes the training estimate.
Whether the halted 2023 attempt's impact assessment is available to the incoming partner.
